_comment: Full-dataset runs for the 2026-08-30 two-tower sweep, chosen from the
pilot in pilot.json. Two cells, each answering one of the two hypotheses
the pilot left open at full scale.
1. budget-8ep is ADR 0006's configuration exactly, run for up to eight
epochs instead of three with early stopping on a loss plateau. It
answers 'was three epochs too little?' directly, and because the
config and seed are v1's, its first three epoch losses must reproduce
v1's 10.3542 -> 10.2726 -> 10.2718 exactly. That doubles as the
full-dataset check that this PR's memory rewrite moved no number.
2. t0.1-5ep holds the learning rate at the default and gives the model
room to speak: at temperature 0.1 the pilot's loss drops below
ln(1 + 16384) = 9.7041 -- the loss of a model with no opinion at all,
which v1 never reached -- and keeps falling. It answers whether an
objective the model can actually fit produces retrieval that works.
Early stopping uses min_delta 1e-4 rather than something larger on
purpose: v1's third epoch improved by 0.0008, and a threshold above that
would stop the budget run at exactly the point it exists to get past.
